zh.title: 華航集團A321neo新機首航高雄澎湖 投入南部航線營運
zh.summary: 華航集團A321neo新機投入南部營運；華信首航高雄澎湖
body: 華航集團規劃將今年最新交付的空中巴士A321neo客機（機身編號B-18135）投入南臺灣市場營運。華信航空於2026年9月13日率先安排該架新機首航國內線高雄至澎湖航線，未來這架客機將以執飛華航自高雄出發的國際航線為主，並視需求支援國內線航班。
為慶祝編號B-18135客機投入營運，高雄與澎湖兩地機場特別安排象徵祝福的航機灑水儀式，共同見證新世代客機投入南部市場。華信航空也在首航航班上為搭機旅客準備限量版首航證書，邀請幸運乘客合影留念。
華航總經理陳漢銘表示，華航集團今年交付的A321neo新機正式投入南部航線營運，在完成國內線班機暖身後，將隨即開始執飛高雄國際航線。華航長期深耕南臺灣市場，將持續透過機隊調配與航線佈局，提升南部地區旅客出國搭機的便利性。
華信航空總經理莊明哲指出，華信航空目前以ATR72-600客機作為國內航線的主力機型，已於2026年上半年順利完成ATR 2.0機隊引進計畫，使現役ATR機隊規模達到13架。
配合華航集團在南臺灣地區的整體營運佈局，華信航空已正式啟動引進A321neo新世代噴射客機的計畫，預計將自2027年下半年起陸續引進兩架A321neo客機。華信航空未來規劃逐步拓展由高雄出發的國際區域航線，以進一步強化南臺灣市場的整體競爭力。

en.title: China Airlines Group Deploys New A321neo to Southern Taiwan with Kaohsiung Flight
en.summary: China Airlines Group deploys a new A321neo in southern Taiwan, launching services on the Kaohsiung-Penghu route.
body: China Airlines Group has deployed a newly delivered Airbus A321neo aircraft, registered as B-18135, to serve the aviation market in southern Taiwan. On September 13, 2026, subsidiary Mandarin Airlines launched the jet's operational service by flying an inaugural domestic route between Kaohsiung and Penghu. The new aircraft will primarily be assigned to China Airlines' international services originating from Kaohsiung, while also supporting domestic routes when needed.

To celebrate the inaugural flight of aircraft B-18135, airport authorities at both Kaohsiung and Penghu arranged traditional water cannon salutes upon the aircraft's arrival and departure. Mandarin Airlines also presented passengers on the maiden flight with limited-edition inaugural flight certificates to mark the entry of the next-generation aircraft into southern Taiwan.

China Airlines General Manager Chen Han-ming stated that the A321neo delivered to the group this year has officially entered operational service in southern Taiwan. Chen noted that after conducting warm-up flights on domestic routes, the aircraft will transition to operating international routes out of Kaohsiung, reinforcing the group's long-term commitment to southern regional passenger demand.

Mandarin Airlines General Manager Chuang Ming-che explained that the carrier currently uses the ATR 72-600 turboprop as its primary aircraft type for domestic operations. The airline completed its ATR 2.0 fleet expansion plan in the first half of 2026, bringing its active ATR turboprop fleet size to 13 aircraft.

In coordination with China Airlines Group's overall strategic footprint in southern Taiwan, Mandarin Airlines has formally initiated a plan to introduce two A321neo jetliners. Delivery of the two new aircraft is scheduled to begin in the second half of 2027, enabling Mandarin Airlines to expand its international regional network from Kaohsiung and boost overall market competitiveness.

zh.title: 亞馬遜貨運航空合作營運模式與全球夥伴航空公司運作現況
zh.summary: 亞馬遜貨運航空由多家合作航空公司營運逾百架貨機與每日航班
body: 亞馬遜貨運航空（Amazon Air）在全球擁有超過100架貨機組成的貨運網路，但該公司本身並非直接執飛的航空公司。根據該公司說明，亞馬遜透過與專業貨運航空公司簽訂合約來提供服務，由合作夥伴提供機組人員、航空器維修支援以及營運所需的監管法規批准。目前這些合作航空公司每日為亞馬遜貨運網路執行超過250個航班。

在北美主要的合作航空公司中，航空運輸服務集團（ATSG）旗下的航空運輸國際（ATI）與ABX Air為主要營運商。根據ATSG的2024年監管申報文件，截至2024年底，ATSG向亞馬遜租賃30架波音767貨機，並同時營運21架由亞馬遜提供的波音767貨機。此外，總部位於明尼阿波利斯的太陽鄉村航空（Sun Country Airlines）自2020年起營運亞馬遜貨運航班，目前執飛20架亞馬遜擁有的貨機。

在大型貨機與國際市場方面，亞馬遜於2022年與夏威夷航空（Hawaiian Airlines）達成協議，由夏威夷航空維修並營運初始由10架空中巴士A330-300客改貨機組成的機隊。在海外網路運作上，亞馬遜在歐洲由ASL航空愛爾蘭（ASL Airlines Ireland）營運貨機，在印度透過ASL集團旗下的QuikJet Airlines執飛，在加拿大亦曾由Cargojet營運亞馬遜擁有的波音767貨機。
根據Cirium的機隊數據顯示，合作營運商21 Air為亞馬遜營運8架貨機。該公司營運的一架亞馬遜塗裝貨機於9月6日在邁阿密國際機場發生跑道偏出事故。美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）目前正在對該起事故進行調查，官方尚未公布任何調查原因。

en.title: Amazon Air Relies on Network of Partner Airlines to Operate Cargo Fleet
en.summary: Amazon Air contracts partner airlines to operate its fleet of over 100 cargo aircraft worldwide.
body: Amazon Air maintains a global air freight network encompassing more than 100 aircraft, but the logistics service does not operate cargo flights directly as a certified air carrier. According to company disclosures regarding its air freight network, Amazon provides services by contracting with specialized partner cargo carriers. These external airlines supply the required pilots, routine aircraft maintenance, and regulatory certifications necessary to conduct everyday operations. Partner carriers currently fly more than 250 daily flights across the Amazon Air network between sorting hubs and fulfilment centers.

Among the major operators in North America, Air Transport Services Group (ATSG) subsidiaries Air Transport International (ATI) and ABX Air maintain a substantial presence in the cargo network. According to ATSG's 2024 SEC filing, ATSG was leasing 30 Boeing 767 freighters to Amazon at the end of 2024 while simultaneously operating 21 Boeing 767 freighters provided directly by Amazon. Additionally, Minneapolis-based Sun Country Airlines has flown cargo flights for Amazon since 2020, operating 20 Amazon-owned freighters.

For high-capacity operations, Amazon announced an agreement in 2022 with Hawaiian Airlines to maintain and operate an initial fleet of 10 Airbus A330-300 converted freighters on Amazon's behalf. Overseas network operations rely on regional airline partners, with ASL Airlines Ireland operating freight flights in Europe and QuikJet Airlines flying dedicated cargo routes in India. Canadian carrier Cargojet has also been utilized by Amazon to operate Boeing 767 freighters.

Fleet data compiled by Cirium indicates that cargo carrier 21 Air operates eight aircraft for Amazon's network. An Amazon-branded cargo jet operated by 21 Air recently made headlines following a runway overrun incident at Miami International Airport on September 6. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is currently conducting an investigation into the occurrence, and official authorities have not yet determined or released any cause for the incident.
